|strategy=By [mailto:ecolson@ix.netcom.com Eric Olson]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/neckandneck.html</ref>

If you're podracing, you'll probably want to be packing a couple of these. This gives you the important ability to prevent your opponent

the first couple of turns, but Anakin can catch up quickly, and when you get close this can give you enough to pull away and make sure [[Sebulba]] will never catch you.

The alternative text can also be extremely useful in a close game. If you have [[Aim High]] out, you can guarantee your opponent won't be retrieving any Force. And even if [[Secret Plans (Dark){{!}}Secret Plans]] is out, you can plan accordingly. Four force retrieved will buy you an extra turn, giving you the chance to win what would otherwise be a lost cause.
